data.text: I appreciate the welcome you’re getting here, Luke, and your care with the lake’s limits. I’ll commit to 15 tons only if all five of us freely agree to April’s shares and a full rotation before we fish. Otherwise, my preference is 10 each—simple, fair, and enough left to replenish the lake. My family taught me to leave fish for tomorrow, and I want that same security for every family here. Emma, you haven’t had your say yet: would you prefer the rotation or an equal split?
